<div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; min-height: calc(100vh - 60px); background-color: #00747A; padding: 2rem; text-align: center;">
  
  <h1 style="color: white; font-size: clamp(3.5rem, 10vw, 8rem); font-weight: 700; margin: 0; font-family: 'Assistant', sans-serif; letter-spacing: clamp(-1px, -0.5vw, -3px);">
    WoSo.Live
  </h1>
  
  <p style="color: white; font-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.25rem); font-weight: 400; margin-top: 1rem; margin-bottom: 0.2rem; max-width: 800px; font-family: 'Assistant', sans-serif;">
    A site for women’s soccer data and visualizations.
  </p>
  <p id="dynamic-caption" style="visibility: hidden; color: white; font-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.25rem); font-weight: 400; margin-top: 0; max-width: 800px; font-family: 'Assistant', sans-serif;">
    Take it for a spin.
  </p>

</div>

<script>
  (function() {
    const callToAction = [
      "Take it for a spin.",
      "Dive into the numbers.",
      "Explore the data.",
      "See the game differently.",
      "Uncover the insights.",
      "It's not just for nerds.",
      "Be your inner spreadsheet person.",
      "Separate signal from noise.",
      "Thanks for visiting!",
      "Bienvenue.",
      "Find something fun and share it for the world to see.",
      "Kick your feet up and stay a while."
    ];
    
    const randomCTA = callToAction[Math.floor(Math.random() * callToAction.length)];
    const captionEl = document.getElementById("dynamic-caption");
    
    if (captionEl) {
      captionEl.innerText = randomCTA;
      captionEl.style.visibility = "visible";
    }
  })();
</script>
